title: Draft Meridian-specific privacy policy page (emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/meridian)
description:
Write a Meridian-specific privacy policy page to be published at https://emberstone-studio.com/docs/privacy/meridian, replacing reliance on the generic Emberstone Studio catch-all policy for the Chrome Web Store submission.

Source material (read these in the repo root, c:\Users\russp\Documents\Meridian):
- PRIVACY.md — existing Meridian privacy disclosures
- STORE_LISTING.md §2.4 and §3 — has paste-ready language and lists the specific gaps that must be covered
- manifest.json — permissions to ground the disclosures against

Must explicitly and specifically cover (per STORE_LISTING.md §2.4 owner-action-needed list):
1. Automatic screenshot capture of visible tabs (captureVisibleTab) — what triggers it, what it can contain, where it's stored (IndexedDB JPEG blobs), retention/eviction behavior (~200 entries/~50MB soft cap, LRU-ish pruning, never evicts a still-open tab, removed on tab close).
2. Automatic per-page content extraction (meta description + H1/H2 headings only, not form input or body text) on page load, used for local search indexing.
3. Automatic tab/browsing-activity collection (titles, URLs, domains, tab-group membership, activation/order) used to render and search tab cards.
4. That chrome.storage.sync preference data (theme, background, search provider, enabled local-search sources, new-tab behavior, homepage, domain grouping) can sync across the user's own signed-in devices via their own Chrome Sync account — this is NOT device-local-only and NOT Meridian-operated syncing.
5. Retention/deletion is accurate: data persists until replaced/evicted/cleared/removed with the extension or profile — do NOT describe it as session data that deletes automatically.
6. Optional bookmarks/history permissions — off by default, only requested when the user explicitly enables that local-search source, no persistent copy kept.
7. No accounts, no analytics, no telemetry, no Meridian-operated backend/server.
8. Outbound links (Emberstone Studio site, Ko-fi) only navigate on explicit user click, no tracking.

Output: Write the final policy page content as Markdown to a new file `docs/privacy-meridian.md` in the repo (or the most sensible docs location — check existing docs/ folder structure first) so the user can review it here before copy-pasting/publishing it to the live URL. Do not attempt to publish it to the live site — that's an owner-only action outside this repo.

Keep tone consistent with PRIVACY.md and STORE_LISTING.md (plain, precise, no marketing language). Cite chrome.storage.local/sync and IndexedDB accurately per the technical detail already reconciled in STORE_LISTING.md.
